 Learn more Revenue growth of 16% and SECaaS ARR increases 41% year-over-year 
 HOD HASHARON, Israel, Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Allot Ltd. (NASDAQ: ALLT) (TASE: ALLT), a leading global provider of innovative Security-as-a-Service (SECaaS) and network intelligence solutions for communications service providers and enterprises, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026. 
 ALLOT Logo Financial Highlights for the Third Quarter of 2026 
 Strong revenue growth to $30.6 million, up 16% year-over-year; 
 Security-as-a-Service (SECaaS) revenues of $9.9 million, increasing 37% year-over-year; 
 September 2026 SECaaS ARR* of $38.8 million, up 41% year-over-year; 
 GAAP operating income of $2.8 million, compared with $2.2 million in the third quarter of 2025; 
 Non-GAAP operating income of $3.9 million compared with $3.7 million in the third quarter of 2025; 
 Operating cash flow of $7.4 million, up 85% compared with $4.0 million in the third quarter of 2025. 
 Management Comment 
 Eyal Harari, CEO of Allot, commented, " This quarter demonstrated continued excellent execution and showed the strength of our business model. Allot is now a sustainably profitable company, and we continue to expand our profitability as we grow our business. We delivered a strong third quarter, combining double-digit revenue growth with improved profitability and robust cash generation. Growth was driven by both SECaaS and SMART solutions, that are both now showing double-digit year-over-year revenue increases. The SMART product growth follows our high level of backlog which we are converting into revenue, following our recent significant wins." 
 Mr. Harari added, "SECaaS ARR continues to grow strongly at 41% year-over-year, further building our recurring revenue base and our visibility into the quarters ahead. We continue to innovate to find new ways to protect consumers, as demonstrated with our recent launch of Allot IOT security. As threat actors use AI to target individuals and businesses at-scale, it is becoming more critical for service providers to provide a layer of protection for their end-customers, supporting demand for cyber-security solutions." 
 Mr. Harari concluded, "Given the momentum, we are raising the midpoint of our guidance for 2026 and narrowing the range to between $116 million and $118 million. We also expect SECaaS revenue growth for 2026, to be above 40%." 
 Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Summary 
 Total revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $30.6 million, a 16% increase year-over-year compared with $26.4 million in the third quarter of 2025. 
 Story Continues Gross profit on a GAAP basis for the third quarter of 2026 was $21.9 million (gross margin of 71.6%), a 16% increase compared with $18.9 million (gross margin of 71.4%) in the third quarter of 2025. 
 Gross profit on a non-GAAP basis for the third quarter of 2026 was $22.0 million (gross margin of 71.9%), a 15% increase compared with $19.1 million (gross margin of 72.2%) in the third quarter of 2025. 
 Operating income on a GAAP basis for the third quarter of 2026 was $2.8 million (operating margin of 9.2%), a 31% increase compared with $2.2 million (operating margin of 8.1%) in the third quarter of 2025. 
 Operating income on a non-GAAP basis for the third quarter of 2026 was $3.9 million (operating margin of 12.9%), a 6% increase compared with $3.7 million (operating margin of 14.0%) in the third quarter of 2025. 
 Net income on a GAAP basis for the third quarter of 2026 was $3.4 million, or $0.07 per diluted share, compared with $2.8 million, or $0.07 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. 
 Net income on a non-GAAP basis for the third quarter of 2026 was $4.7 million, or $0.09 per diluted share, compared with $4.6 million, or $0.10 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. 
 Operating cash flow generated in the quarter was $7.4 million, compared with $4.0 million in the third quarter of 2025. 
 Cash and cash equivalents, bank deposits, restricted deposits and investments as of September 30, 2026, totaled $112 million, compared with $88 million as of December 31, 2025. 
 Conference Call & Webcast : 
 The Allot management team will host a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 earnings results today, November 12, 2026, at 8:30 am ET, 1:30 pm UK, 3:30 pm Israel time. To access the conference call, please dial one of the following numbers: 
 US: 1-888-668-9141, UK: 0-800-917-5108, Israel: +972-3-918-0644 
 A live webcast and, following the end of the call, an archive of the conference call, will be accessible on the Allot website at: https://investors.allot.com/ 
 About Allot 
 Allot Ltd. (NASDAQ: ALLT, TASE: ALLT) is a leading provider of innovative converged cybersecurity solutions and network intelligence offerings for service providers and enterprises worldwide. Allot enhances value to its customers' customers through its solutions, which are deployed globally for network-native cybersecurity services, network and application analytics, traffic control and shaping, and more. Allot's multi-service platforms are deployed by over 500 mobile, fixed and cloud service providers and over 1,000 enterprises. Allot's industry-leading network-native security-as-a-service solution is already used by many millions of subscribers globally. 
 For more information, visit www.allot.com 
 Performance Metrics 
 * SECaaS ARR – measures the current annual recurring SECaaS revenues, calculated as estimated SECaaS revenues for the month of September 2026, multiplied by 12. 
 GAAP to Non-GAAP Reconciliation : 
 The Company presents non–GAAP financial measures that adjust GAAP results to exclude items that management considers not reflective of the Company's ongoing operational performance. Non-GAAP gross profit is defined as GAAP gross profit excluding share-based compensation expenses, amortization of intangible assets and acquisition–related expenses. Non-GAAP operating income is defined as GAAP operating income excluding primarily share-based compensation expenses, amortization of intangible assets and acquisition–related expenses. Non-GAAP net income is defined as GAAP net income excluding primarily share-based compensation expenses, amortization of intangible assets, loss from extinguishment, acquisition–related and other non–recurring expenses, financial income or expenses related to exchange rate differences and changes in tax-related items. 
 These non-GAAP measures should be considered in addition to, and not as a substitute for, comparable GAAP measures. The non-GAAP results and a full reconciliation between GAAP and non-GAAP results are presented below. The Company provides these non-GAAP financial measures because it believes they present a better measure of the Company's core business and management uses the non-GAAP measures internally to evaluate the Company's ongoing performance. Accordingly, the Company believes they are useful to investors in enhancing an understanding of the Company's operating performance.
